kanjidic2.fieldBoundary: Japanese on/kun readings, stroke counts, and classical radical number are metadata evidence only; the old KANJIDIC2 JLPT field is not the frozen community N3 classification.

privateJmdictCapture.exactEntryBoundary: Captured whole expanded JMdict entry objects and exact spelling/reading forms; inspect sense/form restrictions before applying a claim. This does not establish frequency, naturalness of every sentence, or quiz safety.

privateKanjipediaCapture.attributionBoundary: KanjiPedia's displayed historical accounts attribute their explanations to 角川新字源 改訂新版. Captured dictionary prose was read; dictionary glyph pixels were not inspected.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: Hit or strike; object and phrase determine the verb sense.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports ダ, ダース, う.つ, う.ち-, ぶ.つ; JMdict 1408810 verifies 打つ（うつ）, and 1408870 verifies 打撃（だげき）.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus the sound element 丁（テイ→タ）. The modern-shape mnemonic must remain explicitly mnemonic, not etymology.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: 払う can mean to pay or brush/clear away; 支払う is an evidenced compound but its optional word page is absent.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports フツ/ヒツ/ホツ and はら.う/ -はら.い/-ばら.い; JMdict 1501620 verifies 払う（はらう）, and 1310300 verifies 支払う（しはらう） and marks 支 as ateji.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes the old form 拂 as 手 plus the sound element 弗; the current form is its simplified form. Do not infer the old analysis from the modern ム shape.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: Throwing is the primary lesson focus; 投票（とうひょう） supplies a separate evidenced word example.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports トウ and な.げる/-な.げ; JMdict 1447000 verifies 投げる and 1447320 verifies 投票.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus 殳（シュ→トウ）. Remove English-only comparison while retaining the Japanese example.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: The verb 折る covers folding and breaking by bending; the transitive/intransitive distinction in 折る/折れる is retained.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports セツ/シャク and the complete listed kun readings; JMdict 1385910, 1385920, 1589450, and 1288640 verify 折る, 折れる, 折り紙, and 骨折.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia's cited dictionary account describes 斤 plus a cut-wood form and explicitly notes the hand-form as a transmitted error. Do not claim that modern 扌 is the historical component.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: 抜く takes an object out; 抜ける describes something coming out or being missing. Omission is another evidenced use.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports バツ/ハツ/ハイ and the complete listed kun readings; JMdict 1478190 verifies 抜く and 1478200 verifies 抜ける.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes the old form 拔 as 手 plus the sound element 犮（ハツ） and the current form as simplified. Preserve the modern-shape mnemonic as a mnemonic only.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: だく/いだく/かかえる are distinct readings and word usages; do not transfer the mental-state senses of いだく to every だく phrase.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports ホウ and the three kun entries; JMdict 2844997 verifies 抱く（だく）, 1584090 抱く（いだく）, and 1516310 抱える（かかえる）. The だく entry also includes a sexual sense; do not omit that boundary when describing the word broadly.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus the sound element 包（ハウ→ホウ）. The modern reach-around image remains a mnemonic, not proof of construction.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: 押す includes pushing and applying pressure; 押さえる can mean holding down or steady without movement.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports オウ and the complete kun list; JMdict 1180470 verifies 押す, 1589080 押さえる, and 1169250 引く.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus the sound element 甲（カフ→アフ）. The visual note that the central stroke of the right side extends below distinguishes 甲 from 田.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: 招く may invite or beckon; 招待 is an invitation and a noun usable with する.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports ショウ/まね.く; JMdict 1349590 verifies 招く and 1349610 verifies 招待 and its noun/する senses.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus 召（テウ→セウ）. The current gesture image remains a mnemonic.

adjudications.preservedMeaning: 指 as ゆび names fingers/toes; 指す as さす means point or indicate. These are separate words and readings.
adjudications.verifiedReadingsAndExamples: KANJIDIC2 supports シ, ゆび, さ.す, -さ.し; JMdict 1309650 verifies finger/toe, 1309670 指す, and 1309800 指示.
adjudications.historyBoundary: KanjiPedia describes 手 plus the sound element 旨（シ）. The pointing-finger image is a mnemonic only.

invariants.jlptClassification: Use the frozen community N3 snapshot for level membership; KANJIDIC2's legacy jlpt=2 does not supersede it.
invariants.radical: Retain classical radical 64, canonical glyph 手; do not substitute positional 扌.
invariants.ordinaryActiveNegativeQuizSafety: UNVERIFIED for all 27 directions. Retaining source metadata does not establish a safe grading guard.
